per_step.command: cat /app/pending_orders.json
cat /usr/local/bin/dispatch_drones.sh
cat /usr/local/bin/delivery_throughput.sh

# First, let's clear any existing delivery log
> /app/delivery_log.txt

# Create a schedule file
SCHEDULE_FILE="/app/delivery_schedule.json"
echo "[" > $SCHEDULE_FILE

# Process each order
TOTAL_ORDERS=120
SUCCESSFUL_DISPATCHES=0
FAILED_ORDERS=()

for i in $(seq -f "%03g" 1 $TOTAL_ORDERS); do
  ORDER_ID="ORD$i"
  
  # Execute dispatch script
  RESULT=$(/usr/local/bin/dispatch_drones.sh $ORDER_ID 2>&1)
  EXIT_CODE=$?
  
  # Get order details
  ORDER_DETAILS=$(jq --arg id "$ORDER_ID" '.[] | select(.order_id == $id)' /app/pending_orders.json)
  
  if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then
    STATUS="SUCCESS"
    SUCCESSFUL_DISPATCHES=$((SUCCESSFUL_DISPATCHES + 1))
    echo "✓ Dispatched $ORDER_ID successfully"
  else
    STATUS="FAILED"
    FAILED_ORDERS+=($ORDER_ID)
    echo "✗ Failed to dispatch $ORDER_ID: $RESULT"
  fi
  
  # Add to schedule JSON
  if [ $i -lt $TOTAL_ORDERS ]; then
    echo "$ORDER_DETAILS" | jq --arg status "$STATUS" '. + {dispatch_status: $status}' | sed 's/$/,/' >> $SCHEDULE_FILE
  else
    echo "$ORDER_DETAILS" | jq --arg status "$STATUS" '. + {dispatch_status: $status}' >> $SCHEDULE_FILE
  fi
done

echo "]" >> $SCHEDULE_FILE

echo ""
echo "=========================================="
echo "DISPATCH SUMMARY"
echo "=========================================="
echo "Total orders processed: $TOTAL_ORDERS"
echo "Successful dispatches: $SUCCESSFUL_DISPATCHES"
echo "Failed dispatches: ${#FAILED_ORDERS[@]}"
echo ""
echo "Failed orders:"
for order in "${FAILED_ORDERS[@]}"; do
  echo "  - $order (no-fly zone violation)"
done
